definitions.explanation: The property of inhibiting or preventing the growth of bacteria. Widely used in product descriptions for treated materials and surfaces.

examples.japanese: {抗菌|こうきん}{加工|かこう}がされている。
examples.english: It has been given antibacterial treatment.

examples.japanese: このまな{板|いた}は{抗菌|こうきん}{仕様|しよう}で{衛生的|えいせいてき}だ。
examples.english: This cutting board has antibacterial specifications and is hygienic.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{抗菌|こうきん}・{消臭|しょうしゅう}{機能|きのう}がついた{靴下|くつした}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Recently, socks with antibacterial and deodorizing functions have become popular.

notes:
Composed of {抗|こう} (anti-, resist) and {菌|きん} (bacteria, germs). Very common on product labels in Japan, especially for household items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗菌|こうきん}{加工|かこう}: antibacterial treatment/finish
- {抗菌|こうきん}{仕様|しよう}: antibacterial specification
- {抗菌|こうきん}{作用|さよう}: antibacterial action
- {抗菌|こうきん}{剤|ざい}/{抗菌|こうきん}{薬|やく}: antibacterial agent/drug
- {抗菌|こうきん}・{防臭|ぼうしゅう}: antibacterial and deodorant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抗菌|こうきん}: antibacterial — inhibiting bacterial growth
- {殺菌|さっきん}: sterilization — killing bacteria
- {除菌|じょきん}: sanitizing — removing bacteria
- {滅菌|めっきん}: sterilization — completely destroying all microorganisms (medical/lab use)
- {消毒|しょうどく}: disinfection — eliminating pathogens

NOTE:
Japan has a strong market for {抗菌|こうきん} products. The term appears on everything from phone cases and keyboards to socks, towels, and cutting boards.
